tagline: A fast, small pixel art editor and animator
brief: Smalto is a free, open-source pixel art editor and animator (C++/Qt). The name is Italian for the glass tiles of a mosaic, and pixel art is mosaic. The mark should feel crafted, fast, small and a little playful, and must work as a 16 px favicon and as a macOS/Windows app icon.
criteria: Success: unmistakably this app, avoids pixel-pencil and 8-bit-heart clichés, readable at 16 px with the small cut, works in one colour, keeps the old icon's wine colour.

concepts.name: Tessera S
concepts.idea: A pixel S set as mosaic tiles; the last tile, in coral, is still being placed.
rationale: Grout gaps make it mosaic, not just a bitmap letter: the name and the medium in one shape
The tile in motion hints at animation, and gives the brand a story (the next pixel)
Built on a 44-unit grid with one radius and one gap; a gapless cut covers 16–32 px
Wine carries over from the old rosette icon; coral is the only accent

recommendation: Tessera S, in wine with a coral accent tile; the small cut for anything 32 px and under.
next_steps: Check the new app icon in the Dock and taskbar
Swap the manual's favicon for the web icon set
